- *(ci)* The test-ingress-modes tool-install step bounds and retries its network calls (apt with timeout, helm download with curl retries) so a stalled mirror fails fast instead of hanging into CircleCI's 10-minute no-output timeout in [#382](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/382) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
